accounting: K/stake are frozen outputs, not gates; all frozen portfolios are retained with no overlap rejection. Unavailable canonical outcomes receive zero realized stake and are never replaced.
boundary: No matching, candidate ranking, N7 construction, deletion ranking, threshold, budget, or capital amount is regenerated after outcome validation.
legacy_boundary: The superseded segment Gate-A/Gate-B result is non-controlling sensitivity only and is not read by this runner.
primary_unit: complete (issue, fold) instance; no segment is used for selection, tax, participation, overlap, folds, or LOYO
required_diagnostics: ranker_comparison includes matched FULL deltas, stake/gross retention and explicit payout-loss severity; deletion_strata includes calibration and ROI by E_SP, GM_E_SP, probability, predicted-SP and outcome type; issue_support_summary provides per-issue support.
robustness: ALL/YEAR/FOLD/LEAVE_ONE_YEAR_OUT summaries preserve complete issue instances; issue_policy_accounting retains participation and tax buckets.
settlement: A ¥2 sequence pays ¥2×0.65×product(canonical final winning SP) exactly once iff frozen allowed codes cover truth; final SP is uncapped.
tax: Aggregate gross by frozen issue_instance×variant×arm tax_bucket_key; if it reaches ¥10,000, tax each winning portfolio gross at 20%.
